entities.summary: Ezinne Kalu O.O.N. is a professional basketball player for the Zhejiang Golden Bulls of the Women's Chinese Basketball Association (WCBA). Born in the United States, she represents Nigeria at international level. In the 2017, 2019 and 2021 Afrobasket events, she represented D'Tigress, Africa's highest-ranked side and won three straight championship for them. She was named 2019 Women's Afrobasket Most Valuable Player (MVP).
